This product is supplied without battery and charger. Makita 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 676YX.

Cordless multi-tool with tool-less accessory change. Lever-style lock system allows quick accessory replacement at 12 different angles over 360°. Delivers up to 20,000 oscillations per minute. With variable speed control, a battery capacity warning lamp and an anti-restart function for added safety. An ergonomic barrel grip delivers increased comfort while in use. Ideal for wooden flooring, tile, plaster, sheetrock, wood, PVC and a variety of other materials and applications.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
